privacy: Public operator URLs and screening judgments only. No guest lists, emails, or private member data collected. Not for public repo republishing of any future private fields.

city_lock.catchment: Manhattan south of 59th + Brooklyn Williamsburg/Prospect Heights/Park Slope corridor
city_lock.rationale: Highest density of publicly identifiable external-venue small-group dinner operators; competitive learning set (Timeleft/222/Dinner Table) is thickest here.

screener_conditions: ≥2 outside-venue dinners/cultural outings per month (target frequency)
Regularly selects among venues for 4–8 opt-in adults
Event/membership revenue or explicit ops budget
Can show recent planning decisions / recruit opt-in pilot
Can approve plan and complete booking/handoff

funnel.notes: Denominators preserved. Do not treat social posts as interviewed hosts.

operators.revenue_or_budget: not-for-profit; Meetup fee donations twice yearly
operators.screener: PASS_NEAR — frequency and external venues strong; paid SaaS budget unclear (donation-funded Meetup)
operators.include_reason: Exact job shape: rotating restaurants, small tables, host splits bill, food suggestions encouraged.

operators.include_reason: Host books via OpenTable/Resy; taste+diet intake already exists — closest paid recurring external-venue operator in screen.
